newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea considers a second stock exchange - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea considers a second stock exchange - paper.

text.p: The South Korean Finance and Economy Ministry was considering introducing a second stock exchange, the local Chosun Ilbo newspaper on Sunday quoted the finance minister as saying.
"We are considering a second stock exchange to boost venture industries," Kang Kyong-shik was quoted as saying at a meeting on Saturday with businessmen in Pusan, South Korea's second largest city.
The paper said the meeting was sponsored by the Pusan Chamber of Commerce, which has been suggesting that a second stock exchange be established in Pusan.
Kang's quotes in the paper did not say when or where the exchange would be introduced, and officials at the finance ministry were not available for comment.
"We are considering a second bourse which is different from the current one, and we are taking suggestions," he was quoted as saying.
The paper also said that Kang's hometown was Pusan.
